about: Vectors for the x402/exact/lnbtc/payment-hash pairing: the lightning entry point of @integraledger/lcp. H is SHA-256("abc") from FIPS 180-2. The option, its invoice (fixed.x402Invoice), the payment presented, the preimage, the payment hash, the request hashes of requestHashes, the validation time 1700000000, the clock-skew allowance of 60 s and every reason of validate are x402's scheme text, specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_lnbtc.md at x402-foundation/x402 88b66dd4 (PaymentRequirements, PaymentPayload, Request Binding Test Vectors, Facilitator Validation, Paid-but-expired Policy, Error Vocabulary), with extra.paymentHash, this form's member, set to x402's payment hash; payTo is the public key of x402's test-only key 1. Each invoice of invoices was written by bolt11 1.4.1's encode and signed by its sign with the key its encode names (key 1 or key 2, the secp256k1 private keys 1 and 2), which signs deterministically, and is read back by light-bolt11-decoder 3.2.0; bolt11 also writes its default feature bits. BOLT 11 at lightning/bolts 19146282 (11-payment-encoding.md) gives the field rules each refused invoice breaks. The ln/ and x402/ codes are lcp's own (docs/reference/refusals.md) and the order of the checks is the profile's (x402-exact-lnbtc-payment-hash.md): no outside oracle gives a refusal code, so each refusal row starts from the encoding its oracle gives and changes the one member its case names. L1 is BOLT11's published example 'Now send $24 for an entire list of things (hashed)'; L4, an invoice with x402's request hash in h and H in its m field, was made by an encoder that reproduced L1 byte for byte (@scure/base, @noble/curves and @noble/hashes 2.4.0) and is read by light-bolt11-decoder 3.2.0 and bolt11 1.4.1; L7 is L4 with a 4,301-digit amount and its checksum recomputed (BIP-173, in Python).
